name: Miss Behavin'
source:
It's every girl for herself at the country's hottest beauty pageant. Do you have what it takes to outshine the competition and claim the crown?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Miss_Behavin']Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
在这个国家最热门的选美比赛中，每个女孩都是为了自己。你是否有能力在竞争中脱颖而出并夺得桂冠？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Miss_Behavin']Choices Wikia[/url]]
